character: Modern circuit combining long straights, a technical marina section, and a hotel-adjacent corner sequence. Wide, smooth surface with good grip levels; final sector rewards precision for a strong run to the line.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake hard from the main straight, late apex to open the following sequence
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the following corners

corners.name: Turn 5-7
corners.technique: Smooth, rhythmic direction changes, carry as much speed as possible
corners.trap: Over-driving any single apex disrupts the whole sequence

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.type: medium-speed corner leading toward the hotel section
corners.technique: Late apex, prioritise a strong exit
corners.trap: Early apex costs speed through the following corners

corners.name: Hotel Corners
corners.type: technical sequence beneath the Yas Viceroy hotel
corners.technique: Patient, precise inputs through the tightening, visually distracting section
corners.trap: Losing focus under the hotel and missing braking or turn-in points

corners.name: Marina Section
corners.technique: Prioritise clean, low-speed precision over outright commitment
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed into the marina section and running wide
